stage_details.objective: Identify the current unresolved scientific question from the prior Cycle state/Canvas, then return the smallest sufficient candidate set that advances beyond already-established results: one coherent, falsifiable hypothesis when one is sufficient, and at most two additional candidates only when they are genuine competing hypotheses about that same question.
stage_details.may_do: Use the injected Goal/Research Contract, compact Scientific Model/Frontier state, canvas_access, and the workspace path anchors (cycle_dir/workspace_dir/notes_vault_root/repo_root) as stable navigation entry points. Start from frontier_scientific_context.prior_cycle_state and the current Canvas frontier: treat prior established results as already done, unresolved questions as the default frontier, and boundary items as limits that must not be silently crossed. Inspect only scientifically relevant nodes, directly linked reports, or other local artifacts that can change candidate formulation or prioritization. When Frontier State declares an authoritative selected candidate/current scientific boundary, stay inside that unresolved object. A one-candidate shortlist is fully valid. Add a second or third candidate only when it expresses a genuinely different scientific hypothesis that competes to explain or resolve the same current question. State the scientific hypothesis, why it matters now, how it advances the Goal, and this Cycle's decisive_test. The proposed decisive_test must add discriminating information relative to already adjudicated tests; when a repeat-like test is scientifically justified by a new uncertainty, changed condition, independent reproducibility risk, contradiction, or other material difference, make that information gain explicit in why_now or goal_advance. If, and only if, an unresolved external scholarly gap prevents responsible frontier formulation, return the mutually-exclusive needs_literature=true + literature_request tagged output instead of candidates; SDK permits at most one Literature detour for this stage, then you must finish the frontier from the returned Literature result. landscape is preferred; targeted_source requires a concrete source/claim hint. Keep the hypothesis's scientific scope while making decisive_test a feasible, falsifiable local prediction that is genuinely linked to a necessary or otherwise discriminating part of that hypothesis. In decisive_test, distinguish prerequisites from this Cycle's completion conditions and state what a matching, contrary, or inconclusive result would imply for the local prediction and the whole hypothesis. A matching local result may advance the Cycle without supporting the whole hypothesis; a contrary result contradicts the whole hypothesis only when the tested prediction is genuinely necessary under the stated conditions. The SDK freezes decisive_test and derives local Judge criteria from it.
stage_details.must_not: Do not recommend or rank candidates before Challenger qualification, fill the shortlist to a quota, turn a sequential C1→C2→C3 research roadmap into candidates, plan evidence queues or executor routing, or package ordinary data/definition/provenance preparation as a standalone Main Hypothesis unless that preparation is itself the Goal-level scientific claim. Do not spend a new Cycle merely repeating a terminal-supported decisive test, or a scientifically equivalent reformulation of it, just to 'strengthen confidence' when no new uncertainty/condition/reproducibility threat/contradiction would make the result informative. Do not request Literature for ordinary local retrieval, optional background reading, novelty_check, or after one Literature detour has already been supplied in this stage; do not mix literature_request with candidates. Do not copy the entire research Goal or a multi-stage research program into decisive_test; list necessary setup as prerequisites, not as separate completion conditions. Do not present a positive result on one local link as proof of untested downstream links, or introduce an unsupported effect-size threshold merely to make a test binary. Do not execute enough of the discriminating test to adjudicate a candidate or produce its Evidence. SDK-injected Stage Card, Research Contract, Scientific Model, Frontier State and explicit artifact paths are authoritative: do not rediscover workflow/runtime state that the SDK has already supplied. Repository search and artifact inspection are allowed only as needed to formulate or prioritize the scientific question.
stage_details.exit: A minimal shortlist of one to three scientific hypotheses is ready for independent Challenger qualification; if more than one is present, they are genuine alternatives at the same scientific frontier.
procedure: Canvas is your primary scientific working surface. Start at canvas_access.entry_node_id when supplied, read the latest/current frontier content first, and identify the unresolved scientific question before proposing candidates.

Read by scientific relevance, not chronology. Follow relevant Canvas relations outward only when needed; inspect older Hypotheses, Findings, Decisions, Stage summaries, and linked local material only when they can materially change candidate generation or qualification.

Treat canvas_access as an entry point, not a prescribed reading packet. The SDK does not preselect the complete relevant neighborhood for you; you may inspect any Canvas node or workspace material needed for this stage, but do not reconstruct the entire history.

Prefer the newest authoritative scientific state when historical nodes disagree. Use older content for provenance, alternatives, failed routes, or unresolved contradictions, and stop exploring when additional reading is unlikely to change your Lead decision.

Hypothesis continuity is a scientific semantic judgment. When a candidate further tests, refines, or extends the same scientific proposition, reuse the exact existing hypothesis_id found on the Canvas. Omit hypothesis_id only for a scientifically distinct proposition that can independently succeed or fail.

Do not create a new Hypothesis merely because wording changes, scope is reasonably refined or contracted, the decisive_test changes, or the execution method changes. Never invent a hypothesis_id; the SDK validates supplied IDs internally and allocates a new H-xxxx only after a selected candidate omits hypothesis_id.
Your goal is not to reconstruct Canvas history. Read enough of the current scientific frontier to formulate or qualify the next scientifically meaningful hypothesis, then proceed.

stage_details.objective: Independently determine whether each candidate hypothesis and its proposed local decisive_test are ready for one Cycle of investigation.
stage_details.may_do: Assess falsifiability, identifiability, hidden assumptions, causal and estimand coherence, whether the local decisive_test can be adjudicated in one Cycle, whether its possible outcomes genuinely change the assessment of the candidate hypothesis, and whether it adds information beyond already terminal-adjudicated tests visible from the Canvas/history. A local test may establish a necessary intermediate prediction without settling every downstream claim; that is a valid basis for milestone_advanced, not automatically for supported. The injected candidate seed is authoritative for the Candidate itself. Start with that candidate; use canvas_access when historical scientific context, stable Hypothesis identity, or prior decisive-test equivalence matters, follow relevant Canvas relations or linked reports as needed, and stop when additional reading is unlikely to change the qualification judgment. workspace_access is a navigation aid, not a reading list. If a repeat test can be repaired inside the same hypothesis/scope into a genuinely discriminating test, use revise; if the candidate's only scientific value is re-running an already supported equivalent test with no new uncertainty/condition/reproducibility risk/contradiction, reject it.
stage_details.must_not: Do not reject solely because a successful local test cannot prove the whole hypothesis or complete the overall research Goal. Do not qualify a local test that is unrelated to the hypothesis, whose outcomes cannot discriminate any consequential prediction, or that merely repeats a terminal-supported scientifically equivalent test without a stated source of new information. Prior support does not by itself make a repeat unadjudicable, but adjudicability alone is not sufficient for qualification. Do not choose the winner, rewrite the candidate, or perform the investigation. Do not use revise to authorize deleting a research object, changing the core hypothesis or scientific estimand, or abandoning part of the Goal scope already committed by the Candidate; those cases are reject. Do not turn implementation choices, optional robustness analyses, or speculative improvements into qualification blockers unless they affect identifiability or validity of the decisive test. Do not scan the whole repository without a concrete scientific need, and do not rediscover SDK-provided runtime/workflow state. Finding one valid blocker is not sufficient to end the review.
stage_details.exit: Every supplied candidate receives a complete qualification verdict and all independent blocking issues already visible are exhausted. For revise, all such blockers are repairable inside the frozen scientific scope; otherwise the verdict is reject.
procedure: Judge qualification, not scientific truth. Return qualified when the hypothesis is coherent and its local decisive_test is falsifiable, consequential for that hypothesis, and investigable in one Cycle; success need not settle the full hypothesis.

Audit Hypothesis identity semantically. If a candidate supplies hypothesis_id, locate that stable H from canvas_access and compare scientific propositions: allow legitimate wording/scope refinement and a new decisive_test when it is still the same H, but reject reuse of that ID when the candidate is scientifically a different proposition. Do not demand exact hypothesis/scope string equality.

Treat canvas_access/workspace_access as navigation entry points rather than a prescribed packet: candidate first, then only the relevant Canvas history or linked local material needed to judge qualification; do not reconstruct the full branch history.

Use revise only when every blocker is fixable while preserving the Candidate's scientific goal, core hypothesis, research objects, scientific estimand, and already-promised Goal scope. Review the whole candidate, exhaust all independent blockers already visible, and return them together in blocking_issues.

Treat unsupported thresholds, mismatched predicted trends, or inadequate controls as revise blockers when they can be corrected in the local test without changing the hypothesis. If the test is unrelated to any consequential prediction, or repair requires deleting a research object, changing the core Hypothesis, replacing the scientific estimand, or abandoning part of the Goal scope already promised by the Candidate, return reject rather than revise. That change would define a different Candidate.

Do not block on choices the Investigator can resolve without changing that scientific boundary. Optional robustness work, reproducibility preferences, and implementation details are not qualification blockers unless they alter identifiability or validity of the scientific comparison.
For each true revise blocker, return only problem + required_change and state the minimum in-scope clarification needed; do not prescribe a new scientific target or full investigation protocol.

stage_details.objective: Choose exactly one candidate from the already-qualified set and state why it is preferred.
stage_details.may_do: Compare the qualified candidates using scientific value, discriminating power, executability, information gain and cost. The Candidate's decisive_test is already defined upstream and remains the sole Cycle test definition.
stage_details.must_not: Do not re-review Challenger qualification, select revise/reject candidates, regenerate the frontier, restate or redefine decisive_test in the selection reason, create machine criteria, or route specialist roles.
stage_details.exit: One qualified candidate and one concise selection reason are ready for SDK Hypothesis Lock.

stage_details.objective: Repair exactly one Challenger-revise candidate against its frozen blocker ledger without changing the parent Candidate's scientific target or scope.
stage_details.may_do: Select one supplied repair option when more than one is available. Return outcome=resolved only when every frozen blocker can be closed inside the unchanged parent hypothesis/scope. Give exactly one blocker_closure for every blocker id, and return hypothesis clarification, estimand/operational definition, or a decisive-test patch only when that specific patch is actually needed. Return outcome=cannot_repair with a reason when closure would require changing the frozen scientific boundary or repeating already-adjudicated work. The SDK retains the parent hypothesis, goal_advance, scientific scope, title and lineage.
stage_details.must_not: Do not rewrite or replace the full hypothesis, goal_advance, research objects, estimand target, or scientific scope; do not emit 'not needed' placeholder patches; do not rewrite decisive_test when the existing test already survives the blocker repair. Do not reopen frontier search, add evidence-plan queues, or add routing instructions.
stage_details.exit: Exactly one closed-choice result is returned: resolved with complete blocker closures plus only necessary semantic patches, or cannot_repair. The SDK alone decides whether a resolved replacement may enter Hypothesis Lock.
procedure: Treat each supplied repair option as a frozen parent Candidate plus its frozen Challenger blocker ledger. The parent hypothesis, goal_advance, research objects, estimand target and scientific scope are SDK-owned and cannot be replaced in this stage.

Close every blocker exactly once. Use the per-blocker resolution as the authoritative explanation; add hypothesis clarification, estimand/operational definition, or a decisive-test patch only when a blocker genuinely requires that patch. Omit unused patch fields entirely.

Do not narrow the hypothesis boundary, delete a research object, change the scientific estimand, or abandon any promised Goal scope. If a blocker would require one of those changes, it is not repairable under this contract.
Do not restart frontier search, pre-solve independent future objections, or add Evidence Requirement queues/routing. Stop when the frozen blocker ledger is resolved inside the parent scope.

stage_details.objective: Complete the current Lead-derived frozen investigation objective to a discriminating, auditable result using any needed theory, numerical, or task-local source methods.
stage_details.may_do: Select only the method skills required by the current frozen objective under the Investigator skill-routing rule below; derive, compute, inspect supplied local sources, and revise the analysis after seeing results. Produce separate findings with explicit evidence_kind plus scope/limitations and only necessary structured provenance/source identity. Treat every prerequisite stated by the frozen decisive_test as part of the current objective: resolve a prerequisite before an expensive calculation that depends on it, unless that calculation is genuinely prerequisite-independent. Use remaining_scientific_question for any mandatory prerequisite or other work still required by the frozen objective; it may be empty only when those required parts are resolved. Optional future robustness ideas belong in limitations, not as blockers.
stage_details.must_not: Do not change the frozen hypothesis/criteria, adjudicate whether the Hypothesis is proved/supported, write Canvas/Scientific Model, or use Literature for ordinary local retrieval. Do not emit calculation artifact paths, artifact roles, hashes, or Judge-facing Evidence bookkeeping; SDK records invocation artifacts automatically.
stage_details.exit: Continue only while a concrete unresolved part of the frozen investigation objective is necessary, currently executable, and expected to add discriminating evidence. Otherwise return the established findings and, when needed, a precise remaining scientific question.

stage_details.objective: Integrate the newly returned Literature Evidence into the frozen Investigation and complete any now-executable internal reasoning or computation.
stage_details.may_do: Respect source verification and limitations, close definitions/applicability, and immediately perform any internal theoretical/numerical follow-up that is executable from the new source Evidence.
stage_details.must_not: Do not treat failed/unverified retrieval as established source Evidence, restart the whole investigation, or create another Literature request without a genuinely new external scholarly gap.
stage_details.exit: The literature-informed scientific delta is converted into registered internal findings or a precisely stated remaining gap.

stage_details.objective: Address only the authorized Judge objection under the frozen hypothesis and criteria.
stage_details.may_do: Use any internal theory/numerical/local-source method needed for the smallest new discriminating result, respecting do_not_repeat and registered Evidence.
stage_details.must_not: Do not change the hypothesis, broaden the task, replay old Evidence, or split the work into artificial theory/numerical role handoffs.
stage_details.exit: The specified objection has a new evidence-backed update or remains explicitly unresolved with reason.

stage_details.objective: Map the external scholarly landscape for a field/subfield that the current research is entering.
stage_details.may_do: Treat search_target as the complete frozen scholarly assignment and scholarly_retrieval_root as a navigation entry point, not a reading list. Freely list/search/open the SDK-materialized artifacts under that root and follow only the retrieval, reading, citation-trace, or source-text material scientifically needed for this task; identify terminology, major technical routes, seminal/representative papers, method evolution, open questions and a reading order. Use metadata/abstract-level screening for breadth, then verify only the few claims that matter to the current research decision.
stage_details.must_not: Do not open network sockets or call external scholarly APIs/downloaders yourself; external transport is SDK-owned. Do not spend the turn searching ordinary local project files, full-read every retrieved paper, equate citation count with scientific importance, or turn the survey itself into the scientific verdict.
stage_details.exit: A compact external field map exists, representative papers are traceable, key uncertainties are explicit, and any claim-level Evidence is clearly separated from metadata-level coverage.

stage_details.objective: Verify the specific external scholarly source/claim required by the current research gap.
stage_details.may_do: Treat search_target as the complete frozen scholarly assignment and scholarly_retrieval_root as a navigation entry point, not a reading list. Freely list/search/open only the locally materialized retrieval/reading/citation-trace artifacts needed for the target claim and inspect locally downloaded/open-access source text. When source_lock is supplied, treat it as the frozen source identity. Report source-grounded claims and locator/quote verification; SDK semantic closure binds those claims to the Hypothesis, Cycle criterion and Judge objection.
stage_details.must_not: Do not open network sockets or call external scholarly APIs/downloaders yourself; external transport is SDK-owned. Do not perform ordinary local retrieval, restart a broad topic review, recursively request Literature, or keep searching after the source question is answered/unverifiable without a new search lead.
stage_details.exit: The external claim/source is verified/partial/conflict/unverified and handed back with provenance and limitations.

stage_details.objective: Position the current TheoryMaster result/hypothesis against external prior work and novelty/priority risk.
stage_details.may_do: Treat search_target as the complete frozen scholarly assignment and scholarly_retrieval_root as a navigation entry point, not a reading list. Freely list/search/open the SDK-materialized artifacts under that root as needed to identify closest prior work, compare overlap and differences, identify priority risks and required citations, and distinguish apparent novelty from unverified absence of evidence.
stage_details.must_not: Do not open network sockets or call external scholarly APIs/downloaders yourself; external transport is SDK-owned. Do not claim exhaustive novelty, hide conflicting prior work, or use local project search as the task itself.
stage_details.exit: The closest external neighbors and uncertainty of the novelty assessment are explicit enough for Research Lead/Judge to use.

stage_details.objective: Independently adjudicate the frozen decisive test from the supplied scientific result and already-adjudicated same-H progress.
stage_details.may_do: Choose exactly one scientific mode. Terminal mode: verdict=supported|rejected|milestone_advanced|open and objection=null/omitted. Use milestone_advanced when the current decisive_test is resolved but the whole locked hypothesis is not yet established or refuted. prior_adjudicated_context contains already-adjudicated same-H scientific outcomes only: prior milestone_advanced may contribute cumulative progress, while prior open never becomes support merely by appearing in history. Rework mode: verdict=null with exactly one minimal objection. State only the smallest requested_resolution and whether resolving it scientifically requires new external scholarly evidence. If not, set needs_external_scholarship=false and let Investigator freely choose theory/numerical/local-source methods; if yes, set it true and let SDK/Literature own the search strategy and transport.
stage_details.must_not: Do not reopen or request raw CSV/scripts/proofs, Evidence Manifest, Coverage Matrix, Judge Packet, artifact paths or hashes, and do not redo current or prior Investigations. Do not emit criterion_id, objection reason duplicated from rationale, scientific_gap taxonomies, search_target, expected_external_evidence, new_search_lead, per-Evidence assessments, Evidence IDs, executor, budget, routing IDs, artifact paths, or a rework plan. Do not promote a positive local result into whole-hypothesis support, reject the whole hypothesis from a merely inconclusive local result, or request rework for optional robustness, general future work, implementation preferences, unrelated Goal-level work, a changed H/decisive_test/definition, or operational/resource concerns.
stage_details.exit: Return either a terminal verdict with rationale and no objection, or verdict=null with rationale plus exactly one objection{requested_resolution, needs_external_scholarship}. SDK derives C-1 binding, reason, executor, source gap, Literature task, rework plan, authorization, and any forced-open terminalization.

stage_details.objective: Independently decide whether the original Research Goal and Final Gate are satisfied by the completed research trajectory.
stage_details.may_do: Treat research_plan_access and canvas_access as the two primary authoritative inputs. Read research_plan.md for Goal, Research Contract, Final Gate and Required Context, then inspect the Canvas for the completed Hypothesis/Decision trajectory. In the normal case, decide from those two sources alone. Only when they are genuinely insufficient may you search or open additional local linked reports, artifacts, Evidence, Scientific Model material, or workspace files needed to resolve the specific completion question. Return verdict=passed only when the Final Gate is actually satisfied; otherwise return verdict=not_passed with the smallest concrete remaining Goal-level gap.
stage_details.must_not: Do not treat optional future science, generic open questions, or work outside the stated Goal/Final Gate as blockers. Do not propose the next Candidate, change the Scientific Model, alter prior Judge verdicts, redo the Investigation, or perform broad repository exploration by default. Do not add routing, executor, budget, Evidence IDs, artifact inventories, or a research plan to the output.
stage_details.exit: Return verdict=passed with no remaining_gap, or verdict=not_passed with exactly one concise remaining_gap describing what the stated Goal/Final Gate still requires.

stage_details.objective: Synthesize the terminal Judge decision, then decide whether the long-term Scientific Model should stay unchanged or be conservatively edited as one complete document.
stage_details.may_do: Start from the compact active_hypothesis and terminal Judge verdict/rationale. Use scientific_access as stable navigation and open the Evidence manifest or other scientific material only when needed. Make conclusions[] the compact statements this Cycle actually established and open_questions[] the genuine scientific questions still unresolved after the verdict; these fields become the authorized cross-Cycle handoff and Canvas state digest, so do not use open_questions for optional nice-to-have analyses. Return action=keep when this Cycle adds no durable long-term scientific change and omit model entirely. When action=replace, first read the complete prior Scientific Model from scientific_access.scientific_model_path, then return one complete durable Scientific Model object with established knowledge and current scientific picture only.
stage_details.must_not: Do not attach or echo a full Scientific Model when action=keep. Do not regenerate the Scientific Model from this Cycle alone, silently drop durable knowledge, change the human Goal/Research Contract, override the Judge verdict, reopen qualification, or force a model version change merely because a Cycle ended. Preserve Evidence scope/limitations exactly enough to distinguish sourced facts from a new operational convention or modeling assumption; never upgrade one chosen mathematical operationalization into the source's unique or 'strict' definition unless the registered source Evidence establishes that equivalence.
stage_details.exit: Scientific synthesis explicitly states what is established and what remains unresolved, and one keep/replace Scientific Model decision is ready for SDK validation/persistence and deterministic cross-Cycle projection.

stage_details.objective: Write a human-first post-Judge scientific narrative from already-decided state.
stage_details.may_do: Explain the scientific question, key evidence/data, interpretation, counter-explanations, limitations, and model-level meaning in clear research prose from the already-decided branch and committed Scientific Model state.
stage_details.must_not: Do not dump JSON/YAML, schemas, contracts, Agent deliveries, raw ModelPatch/evolution-candidate objects, runtime state, or internal field names into the human report. Do not create/modify candidates, change the Judge verdict or Scientific Model state, assess overall Goal completion, or write files directly. Preserve decisive Evidence scope/limitations, especially the distinction between a sourced scientific statement and a newly chosen operational convention; do not strengthen 'consistent with' or 'under convention X' into a unique/strict source definition.
stage_details.exit: A title and self-contained human-readable summary are ready; SDK will append only machine-record indexes at the end.

stage_details.objective: Author minimal human-readable Canvas copy after a terminal Cycle without taking graph, lineage, or frontier authority.
stage_details.may_do: Use only the SDK-injected canvas_focus, terminal Decision, Evidence scope digest, persisted Cycle dossier, and already-authorized frontier context; write one concise Decision title/summary and, when authorized, one concise frontier title/summary. SDK will append the authorized Cycle scientific-state digest (Established / Unresolved / Boundary) deterministically; Reporter does not need to restate or invent it.
stage_details.must_not: Do not open, scan or grep the full branch Canvas; canvas_focus is the authoritative Canvas context for this invocation. Do not return or infer node IDs, parent/wiring, status, Evidence refs, note links, creates/updates, Findings, removal lists, frontier IDs, next-start IDs, colors/layout, or file writes. Do not alter the Judge verdict, invent or select a frontier, or strengthen registered scope/limitations and operational-convention boundaries.
stage_details.exit: Return only the minimal canvas_maintenance authoring fields: Decision copy, optional authorized-frontier copy, and rationale. SDK closure constructs and validates the Canvas patch.
